scenario: Companion-slot access per LSER.6.1 — authors reference maintained statistics on a schema binding via `t.mean`, `t.stdev`, etc. Pin: `where s.mean > 5.0` on a schema with a declared `mean, stdev` series compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no value is read.
rules_ds:
use default

schema SensorData scope ttl 1_min:
    entity_id: String
    state: Float

series SensorData.state (by: entity_id):
    mean, stdev sliding 10_min

rule high_mean:
    SensorData s where s.mean > 5.0
->
    log info "high mean"
